dependencies.name: Expat
dependencies.finding: The exact upstream 2.8.4 changelog records the reviewed 2026 security fixes; the upstream project advisory page listed no published GitHub advisories at review time.

dependencies.name: zlib
dependencies.finding: The upstream releases page identifies 1.3.2 as latest and states that it addresses the completed security-audit findings; the project advisory page listed no published GitHub advisories at review time.

dependencies.name: LZ4
dependencies.finding: The upstream advisory page listed no published advisories. Open issue 1783 concerns deprecated unsafe LZ4_decompress_fast APIs; mmxisf uses LZ4_decompress_safe and does not call the reported API.

dependencies.name: Zstandard
dependencies.finding: The exact upstream 1.5.7 release and the project advisory page were reviewed; the advisory page listed no published GitHub advisories. mmxisf uses the core block APIs, not the contributed seekable format.

dependencies.name: OpenSSL
dependencies.finding: The official 3.6 notes identify 3.6.4 as a security patch release, and the vulnerability list identifies the reviewed 3.6-series issues as affecting versions before 3.6.4.
